_comment: State of the 12-hour BIP39 seed grid read off clues/powerfulmoss-poap.png. Each clock hour overlays a cell of the alphabetical BIP39 wordlist rendered as wrapped monospace flow-text; the numeral's row can only be pinned to +/-1 row on the published 2004x2011 raster, so most hours carry 3 candidate words (the row above, the row read, the row below) rather than 1 confirmed word. 3 hours were read cleanly by eye (the numeral sits squarely on one word with no row ambiguity). Source: results/STATUS.md, 2026-06-17 GRID-READ pass (candidate columns) and 2026-07-14 grid-enumeration pass (same candidate columns, oracle-tested).
